order_constraints.scope: In the seven-site ancestral-background assay cube, every functional genotype containing T52F also has F46T or T93P. At least one must precede T52F along a path constrained to functional measured intermediates. Neither is universally sufficient on all larger backgrounds. Derived from normalized S1 Table; source curation caveats apply. Because genotype0111011 is reconstructed from a probable printed-label typo, treat this universal rule as provisional rather than unqualified experimental order truth.
order_constraints.locator: S1 Table:0010000 nonfunctional;1010000 and0010100 functional at356nm; all functional T52F-containing rows
order_constraints.scoring_status: provisional: depends on normalized S1 Table, including the unconfirmed missing-genotype repair

order_constraints.scope: T52F alone on the assayed ancestral background does not form functional pigment. It therefore cannot be the first step on a seven-site path required to retain functional pigment at every intermediate. This does not say which of the other six substitutions is sufficient to permit it.

assay_data.scoring_status: Historical order and explicitly measured genotype contrasts are available. Exact accessible-path-set scoring is provisional pending reconciliation of source table/path discrepancies. Do not treat1076 as a reproduction of1032.
assay_data.spectrum_rule: Use lambda_max_nm only for functional measured pigments. published_inferred_lambda_max_nm is not an experimental spectrum.

alignment.note: The seven paper amino-acid directions define the source truth. A model run without an ancestral row uses its own inferred/plurality background and must report it; that is not the experimental ancestral construct.

missing_before_scoring: Reconcile S1 Table probable duplicated genotype label0011011 and missing0111011, bold-only inferred value1010011, and published1032 accessible paths vs1076 from normalized table. Full discrepancy documented per record.
The seven-site assays used chimeric AncBoreotheria S1 with anole termini. Natural extant sequences are model inputs, not identical assay backgrounds.
1U19 is a bovine rod-opsin homolog template only. It does not validate SWS1 distances or a dark-noise mechanism.
not_established: A unique historical permutation within the three two-substitution stages.
Biochemical necessity of the entire phylogenetically inferred four-stage order.
